full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff respondents filed a suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in the suit land by evicting the defendants. The plaintiffs' case, in short is that the suit land was recorded in C.S. Khatian No. 160 of mouza Borai and the plaintiffs, by an amicable partition amongst themselves and pro-defendants, were possessing the same; that during the last c.s. operation Jasmat Sardar  was possessing the suit land as a barga darunder Girish Chandra and others, the plaintiffs predecessors, on delivering half of the produce of the land from year to year; and that during Jasmat Sardar's life time the land was taken and given borga bandabosta to others. As Jasmat was possessing the land as borgadar his name was wrongly recorded in the C.S. record as tenant paying borga rent though he was never recognized as a tenant by the plaintiffs' predecessors. Acting on rumors, that lands recorded in the names of bargadars paying half the produce as rent, had vested in the bargadar's ; defendants, 1, 2, and 3, got fraudulent kabala from Jasmat's daughters, defendants 4 and 5 and forcibly dispossessed the plaintiff's from the suit land in Baishak, 1364 B.S. and hence the suit.
